name: Shin'yuu ga Bishoujo ni Natte Kaette kita.
original_name: 親友が美少女になって帰ってきた。
source:
Sakaguchi Takashi is a fairly typical, if somewhat lonesome, Japanese high school student. One day, he runs into a beautiful girl who claims to already know him. He has no memory of having such a pretty friend, but there is something familiar about her... could it be?

His close childhood friend Ayumu has finally returned after a long hospitalization, only something is different: She had been a boy! Takashi will have a tough time adjusting to a beautiful girl with the personality and mannerisms of his childhood best friend. How will their relationship develop now?
translation:
坂口崇是一名颇为普通、只是稍显孤独的日本高中生。某天，他遇见了一个声称早已认识自己的美少女。崇不记得有这样漂亮的朋友，却又觉得她身上有些熟悉……难道她是？

儿时挚友周あゆむ经历漫长住院后终于回来，然而有件事变得不同：过去的他明明是男孩！面对一个拥有童年死党性格与举止的美少女，崇恐怕很难适应。两人的关系如今会怎样发展？
